messages.body:
Dear Alex,

Your renewal paperwork is ready. Please sign and return it by Monday so we can lock in the current rate.

Regards,
Gwen Albright
Harborview Rentals
Just a friendly reminder about Monday's deadline.

note.text: Gwen promised the broken dishwasher would be replaced before the renewal. It has not been replaced yet.

question: Should I sign the renewal this week?
fact: Gwen promised to replace the broken dishwasher before the renewal, and it has not been replaced.
